subject: *: generalize columnar for DDL (#60244)
summary: Within executor/planner/statistics/table, this commit consistently switches TiFlash-local/vector index checks to the generalized `IndexInfo.IsColumnarIndex()` / `IndexInfo.GetColumnarIndexType()` plumbing. In the reviewed runtime paths (admin check/cleanup, access path selection, analyze/auto-analyze, and KV index maintenance), behavior remains effectively unchanged because `IsColumnarIndex()` is still implemented as `VectorInfo != nil` in this commit, so columnar/vector indexes continue to be skipped where they must not be treated like TiKV-backed secondary indexes.
